text:
Zara Osei: Hey all, Zara here — excited to join Product Infra as a platform engineer. First day! :tada: Quick setup Q: my MacBook asked for an MDM PIN but I never got an invite. Who should I ping?

Jamie Park: Welcome Zara!! :tada: I'll DM you a buddy. @Samir will take you through day-one stuff. For MDM/MDM invites ping @Lina (IT). Also add yourself to #platform and #dev-oncall.

Samir Chen: hey Zara, congrats! I'll book a 30m buddy sync. We can pair on the repo checkout and a tiny PR later. If you're around for a coffee break we can do a quick intro to our pager flow.

Lina (IT): Hi Zara — sorry about the delay. Can you check for an email from "Okta Device Management" (sometimes goes to promotions)? If not, tell me the laptop serial and I'll re-send. After invite, run this to verify enrollment:
```bash
# mac enroll
sudo profiles install -type enrollment -path /tmp/okta.mobileconfig
profiles status -type enrollment
```

Zara Osei: Thanks @Lina — no email found (checked spam). Laptop serial is ABC123DEF.

Lina (IT): Got it. Re-sent invite to zara.osei@redwood.ai. If it doesn't arrive in 5m I'll create a manual MDM token and force-provision so Slack/Google/Github are provisioned.

devops-bot: Provisioning event — created user zara.osei; added to teams: platform-engineering; channels: #new-hires,#platform; projects: dev-platform.

Kevin (Security): Hi Zara — welcome! Reminder to enroll in MFA and request hardware 2FA if you want a YubiKey (ops-ticket #9876).

Alyssa (Design): hey neighbour team! where are you located? we do a local lunch rota. :)

Zara Osei: Toronto (EST). Also fun fact: I bake sourdough on weekends. :bread:

Samir Chen: love it. sourdough club! i'll add you to the lunch group calendar.

Lina (IT): Invite delivered — let me know when you finish enrollment.

Zara Osei: enrolled now — MDM status shows "Compliant". Trying to SSH into jump host but getting `Permission denied (publickey)`. I uploaded my pubkey to the onboarding repo but maybe put it in the wrong place.

Jamie Park: Put the public key under https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-keys in a file named zara.pub with your GitHub handle. If it's already there @ops-bot can run the key-sync.

ops-bot: SSH key sync started for zara.osei — estimated 90s.

ops-bot: SSH key sync complete. Keys propagated to dev jump hosts.

Zara Osei: yep, SSH works now. Thanks! Final quick Q — where's the first-week checklist?

Jamie Park: Internal doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/first-week. TL;DR: enroll MDM, add SSH key, request 2FA, join channels, shadow on-call, run quick PR. I'll add a 1hr onboarding sync at 4pm.

Lina (IT): Just gave camera permission in MDM for Zoom. You should be good.

Zara Osei: All set — super grateful. Looking forward to pairing later today! :sparkles:
